basics.title: Mid Web Developer
basics.summary: With over 5 years of experience in the IT industry, I am a proficient and disciplined Software Developer. My expertise relies on Salesforce and .NET Technologies. I Have fluent English, an active team player, with strong dedication to knowledge sharing. I love taking care of the business as I can by creating solutions and clear documentation to share the knowledge with my team mates.

work.summary: I am part of a specialized team that develops custom plugins for an ERP, tailored to each client's unique business logic. This role requires adaptability to meet evolving client demands and maintaining consistent communication with the team. My primary tools include the .NET Framework, Salesforce, SQL Server and JavaScript; I also contribute to detailed project documentation to ensure clarity and continuity. I have built integrations that uses REST APIs, EDI parsing, and GraphQL APIs, including integration with other databases.
highlights: Architected a custom logging library for internal use, reducing debugging time and improving observability of system customizations
Increased Apex code coverage to 85% through the strategic implementation of unit tests
Optimized SQL Server query performance to support high-volume transactions
Produced onboarding materials and trained new employees, resulting in increased productivity and higher code quality
Led a REST-to-GraphQL migration using .NET Framework by designing and implementing a new architecture
Proactively established workshops to explain complex technical business logic and processes

Each sub-project focuses on solving specific UI/UX problems—ranging from responsive layouts to complex state management—ensuring that every component is built for scalability and accessibility.

education.title: Salesforce Development
education.summary: Successfully completed an intensive five-month, full-time Full Stack Web Development training program, with a primary focus on Salesforce development. Gained practical expertise in web development techniques based on Salesforce, including creating user-friendly and adaptable web interfaces with Aura, LWC and Visualforce, implementing strong foundational architectural and design patterns with Apex, and integrating version control systems. Additionally, I developed complete applications using the out of the box tools provided by Salesforce. Acquired valuable insights into the application of Agile development principles and established proficiency with industry-standard development tools and best practices by actively collaborating with my team mates.
